headline: KEPCO confirmed exposure for 650,487 billing users, an attack disrupted three Guadeloupe University Hospital sites, and Samsung Securities reported 8,241 people affected. Have I Been Pwned indexed 355,051 email addresses from Bromcom’s previously disclosed September breach.

incidents.what: KEPCO confirmed exposure for 650,487 billing users and notified all 869,761 procurement users while it investigates the scope of the breach in that system.
The hospital director said encrypted databases and disrupted phones and clinical systems forced three sites to postpone non-urgent care.
The brokerage confirmed that an intrusion into its customer feedback system exposed personal information, including some account and driver’s license numbers.
The Block estimated about $2 million in attacker proceeds and separately valued later withdrawals from Fusionist’s bridge reserves at about $3.7 million.
Police took the network offline after detecting a potential database intrusion; phones, radio and calls for service continued normally.
incidents.scale: Network offline; no evidence of personal data access

incidents.what: VECERT relayed an online claim of data theft from Kenya’s eCitizen platform; no compromise or data loss has been verified.
FrenchBreaches reported finding 118,130 distinct email addresses in files attributed to the nonprofit, but could not establish their origin.
INC Ransom’s claim remains unverified; the company says its own systems are secure and employee immigration records may have been taken from a law firm.
Scarlettgroup listed the hospital on its leak site; unauthorized access, data theft and service disruption remain unconfirmed.
The vendor said it patched a vulnerability and restored access to the Mail Assure and SpamExperts dashboard and APIs after an earlier intrusion.
The retailer planned to resume direct-order shipping in stages from November 23, but gave no reopening date for its online store.
Have I Been Pwned indexed 355,051 distinct email addresses from the education software provider’s September sign-on registration breach.
